# Fixtures for rd_shadow_tile_ab (port/render/test/rd_shadow_tile_ab.cmake:
# the shadow composites drawn whole against over the GPU tile mask, byte for
# byte): fixture names of this repository (port/render/test/fixtures/
# NAME.rdfix), a name a line.  After the name: the composites drawn over the
# tile mask in one replay at the phone setting (the frame's three), then the
# bounds on the live texels of SHADOW0's, SHADOW1's and SHADOW2's masks
# there.  A bound comes from the fixture's own pass dump at the phone setting
# (the PS2-size levels): the box of the level's texels with alpha above 0,
# (x0,y0)-(x1,y1); a mask texel i stands for level texels 2i - 3 .. 2i + 4
# (its block of 2 and 3 texels about it), so it can be live only for
# ceil((x0 - 4) / 2) <= i <= floor((x1 + 3) / 2), and the same down.
#
# a character's shadow at 21:9: SHADOW0 (110,85)-(317,139) of 424x256, 108 x
# 31; SHADOW1 (55,43)-(158,69) of 212x128, 55 x 17; SHADOW2 (38,31)-(79,34)
# of 106x64, 25 x 5
fx-shadow-wide 3 3348 935 125
